rules.title: Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources when ending a tenancy
rules.requirement: Landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement must give the renter a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also submit tenant contact information and a copy of the notice to the City through the online portal.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies when a landlord is planning to end a tenancy agreement; the City submission requirement also applies to foreclosing owners.
coverage.summary: All Boston landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement are covered.

rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. Failure to submit required information may result in a fine up to $300 per day.
rules.interaction: The document states that a landlord’s violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
